name: claude
description: Trigger: start an implementing run. Added last; removed by the run.

name: needs-input
description: A run asked a question or left a draft. Answer or decide, then remove this.

name: epic
description: A /plan parent issue holding sub-issues. Never dispatched; closed by hand.

name: model:opus
description: Attribute: run on Opus. Escalation path.

name: model:fable
description: Attribute: run on Fable. Explicit; bills usage credits.

name: advisor:opus
description: Attribute: Opus advises the main model (default unless model:fable).

name: advisor:fable
description: Attribute: Fable advises the main model. The only advisor for model:fable.

name: risk:high
description: Auth, payments, deletion, migrations. Mandatory diff read; security-focused review.
